description:
List the files attached to one element (`type` and `id`, a UUID) in the
world named by your API-Key header: PDFs, text files and world bundles kept
on onlyworlds.com beside the element, never inside it.

Returns `{data: [{id, name, kind, size, label, added_by, added_at}, ...]}`,
newest first. `label` is the field the file belongs to, free text, or null;
`added_by` says who added it and whether an agent did. You see a file
exactly when you may see its element. Read a text file's words with
`read_file(file_id)`. Requires a READ or WRITE API-Key.

world.description: The world to read, by id or by its public page's slug. With an API-Key, leave it out (or name the key's own world): a key reads its own world only. list_worlds names the worlds you can read here.

name: list_files
